title: Hal-e-sakina
body:
BAAD E HUSSAIN HAAL E SAKINA HO KYA BAYAA'N
HAI ZULM KE PAHAD WOH NANHI SI EK JAAN
1.JAB RAN SE ZULJANAH SUE KHAIMA AYA THA
MASOOMIYAT SE BACCHI NE BAS ITNA PUCHA THA
WAQT E ZIBHA THE PYAASE YA SERAAB BABA JAAN
BAAD E HUSSAIN HAAL E SAKINA HO KYA BAYAA'N...... 2
2.JAB GOSHWAARE CHE ENE GAYE AUR LAHOO BAHA
DARIYA KI SIMT RUKH KIYA RO ROKE YE KAHA
BABA MADAD KO AYIYE LILLAHA AMMU JAAN
BAAD E HUSSAIN HAAL E SAKINA HO KYA BAYAA'N.... 2
3.DAMAN MAI MERE AYIYE BABA HAI ILTEJA
KEHTE HUE FAILA DIYA KURTA JALAYA HUA
LETA HAI AB YAZEED MOHABBAT KA IMTEHAN
BAAD E HUSSAIN HAAL E SAKINA HO KYA BAYAA'N.... 2
4.PAANI JO RASTE MAI LAENO SE MANGA THA
MUJH KO DIKHA DIKHA KE ZAMEEN PAR BAHADIYA
KOI NAHI THA HOTA JO USS WAQT MEHERBAA'N
BAAD E HUSSAIN HAAL E SAKINA HO KYA BAYAA'N... 2
5.DAKHEEL HUE JO SHAAM MAI AYA WOH MARHALA
BHAI KA SAR JHUKA THA TOH PHUPHIYON KA SAR KHULA
GAIRAT SE SAR JHUKAYE THA BEMAAR NA TAWAA'N
BAAD E HUSSAIN HAAL E SAKINA HO KYA BAYAA'N... 2
masaib....
BAITI THI APNE BABA KE PURSE KE AAAS MAI
ZINDAAN MAI KATA HUA SAR AYA PASS MAI
DIKH LAYE ZAKHMI KAAN WOH DURRO KE BHI NISHAA'N
BAAD E HUSSAIN HAAL E SAKINA HO KYA BAYAA'N.... 2
BHAI KO MERE KAATON PAI PAIDAL CHALA DIYA
EK UNTH PAR ALHEEDA MUJH KO BITHA DIYA
AKHON MAI ASHK THE TOH LABOON PAR BACHA LO MAA'N
BAAD E HUSSAIN HAAL E SAKINA HO KYA BAYAA'N.... 2
CHAAR BARAS KI UMR MAI YOUN GHUM NASEEB THI
*MEHFOOZ* WOH SITAM HUE HALAT AJEEB THI
*SADIQ* TAMAM ZULM NA KAR PAYGA BAYAA'N
BAAD E HUSSAIN HAAL E SAKINA HO KYA BAYAA'N... 2
